newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Government minister undergoes emergency surgery.
newsitem.headline: NZ Government minister undergoes emergency surgery.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Sept 19 - Police Minister John Luxton has had emergency surgery for a twisted bowel after being admitted to Wellington Hospital last night, the New Zealand Press Association reported on Thursday.
A hospital spokeswoman this morning said Luxton's condition was not available, however his office said he was recovering.
His election engagements have been cancelled in the meantime.
Luxton, 50, is currently MP for Matamata and is standing for election in the new seat of Karapiro.
He is widowed with three children and on Monday announced his engagement to Wellington barrister Mary Scholtens.
Luxton is also Minister of Maori Affairs, Minister of Commerce and Minister for Industry.
